responsibility: Implements the UTF encoding and decoding primitives used by the D front end. It validates Unicode scalar values, classifies alphabetic code points, computes code-unit lengths, and encodes or decodes UTF-8 and UTF-16 sequences with explicit error strings for malformed, overlong, or out-of-range data.
same_name_distinction: Implements the UTF helpers declared in gcc/d/dmd/utf.h: validation, alpha classification search, code-unit length calculation, encoding, decoding, stride tables, and concrete error-string definitions. Unlike the header, it contains the executable Unicode processing logic rather than the public types, tables, and declarations.
